It is a reminder of the spiritual pursuit of enlightenment and the belief in the power of inner light to guide and illuminate one's path towards self-realization and ultimate union with the Divine. historical_references.reference: Rohanesh is mentioned in the 'Mahabharata', an ancient Indian epic poem. He was a charioteer of Arjuna, one of the five Pandava brothers, during the Kurukshetra War in the 9th century BCE.

Another reference to Rohanesh can be found in the 'Puranas', a collection of ancient Indian texts. Rohanesh is considered an incarnation of Lord Shiva, who came to the aid of the demon king Ravana during his war against Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, in the 5th century BCE.
